items.title: Matas Buzelis talked a lot about freedom yesterday.
items.author: Drew
items.body_excerpt:
Matas Buzelis talked a lot about freedom yesterday.

He expects “a little more leeway” and “more freedom to play how I want.” He even mentioned “not over-coaching” when asked about Caleb Wilson.

Like Bryson Graham’s flexibility, Buzelis’s freedom will only be as good as what he makes of it.
